description: Read recent room chat: persisted chat history plus recent AI messages, merged by time and decrypted server-side (the roomId is the read capability — same trust model as send_message). Works only on live, unmoderated, unlocked rooms; an empty pond has no history.

since.description: ISO-8601 timestamp — only messages after it.

name: get_messages

receivedAt.description: Server receipt ISO-8601 — use as the `since` cursor

title: Get messages
